```sql
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           o.id               AS order_id,
           pv.id              AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)               AS order_count,
           sum(q)::bigint         AS quantity,
           sum(r)                 AS revenue_cents
      FROM (
            SELECT product_id, order_id,
                   sum(quantity)         AS q,
                   sum(line_total_cents) AS r
              FROM base
             GROUP BY product_id, order_id
           ) x
     GROUP BY product_id
),
per_variant AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM base) v
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       po.order_count,
       po.quantity,
       po.revenue_cents,
       pvc.variant_count
  FROM per_order po
  JOIN per_variant pvc ON pvc.product_id = po.product_id
  JOIN products p      ON p.id = po.product_id
 ORDER BY po.quantity DESC, po.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De dure sort op (product, order) met schijf-spill voor de twee `count(DISTINCT …)` is vervangen door hash-aggregaties op een eenmalig berekende, kleine tussenset. Daarna wordt `products` pas gejoind op de al geaggregeerde rijen. Datatypes van de sommen (`bigint` voor quantity, `numeric` voor revenue) blijven gelijk aan het origineel.
